text.p: PacifiCorp said Tuesday a consortium of energy producers including it, National Power Plc, Destec Energy Inc. and the Commonwealth Bank Group of Australia have completed the acquisition of a power station in Australia for about $1.9 billion.

The consortium, known as Hazelwood Power, financed the purchase of the 1,600 megawatt generating station and associated coal mine in the state of Victoria with about $858 million in equity contributions and $1 billion of borrowings.
Portland, Ore.-based PacifiCorp's portion of the equity investment was about $155 million.
National Power will oversee Hazelwood plant operations and PacifiCorp will oversee operations at the adjacent Hazelwood mine, it said.
PacifiCorp's stock was unchanged at $20.75 on the New York Stock Exchange at midday.
